records.source: אֹהֵ֣ב מ֭וּסָראֹ֣הֵֽב דָּ֑עַת וְשֹׂנֵ֖א תוֹכַ֣חַת בָּֽעַר׃
records.gloss: [One] loving discipline loves knowledge, but [one] hating rebuke [is] stupid.
pieces: To love discipline is to love knowledge; \q to hate correction is plain stupidity.

L.1: Whoever loves discipline loves knowledge, \q but whoever hates rebuke [is] stupid.

R.1: If you love to learn, you will accept correction. \q Only a stupid person hates to be corrected.

decisions.choice: stupid: brutish, like an animal
decisions.reason: The word (baar) is related to the word for cattle: someone with no more sense than a beast (30:2; Psalm 73:22).

records.source: ט֗וֹב יָפִ֣יק רָ֭צוֹן מֵיְהוָ֑ה וְאִ֖ישׁ מְזִמּ֣וֹת יַרְשִֽׁיעַ׃
records.gloss: A good [person] obtains favor from YHWH, but a person of schemes he condemns.
pieces: A good person wins favor from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q but {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} condemns the one who plots evil.

L.2: [The] good obtains favor from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q but a person of schemes {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} condemns.

R.2: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is pleased with good people. \q But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} judges people who plan to do evil.

decisions.choice: schemes: evil plans
decisions.reason: The word (mezimmot) is the "discretion" of 1:4, here used in its bad sense: plotting (14:17).

records.source: לֹא־יִכּ֣וֹן אָדָ֣ם בְּרֶ֑שַׁע וְשֹׁ֥רֶשׁ צַ֝דִּיקִ֗ים בַּל־יִמּֽוֹט׃
records.gloss: A person is not established by wickedness, but [the] root of righteous [people] will not be moved.
pieces: No one is made secure by wickedness, \q but the roots of the righteous cannot be dislodged.

L.3: A person is not established by wickedness, \q but [the] root of [the] righteous will not be moved.

R.3: Doing evil will not make anyone safe. \q But good people are like a tree with deep roots.

decisions.choice: the root will not be moved: firmly planted
decisions.reason: The righteous are like a well-rooted tree (verse 12; Psalm 1:3).

records.source: אֵֽשֶׁת־חַ֭יִל עֲטֶ֣רֶת בַּעְלָ֑הּ וּכְרָקָ֖ב בְּעַצְמוֹתָ֣יו מְבִישָֽׁה׃
records.gloss: A wife of strength [is the] crown of her husband, but like rottenness in his bones [is one] acting shamefully.
pieces: A capable wife is a crown on her husband's head, \q but a wife who disgraces him is decay in his bones.

L.4: A wife of strength [is the] crown of her husband, \q but like rot in his bones [is one] who brings shame.

R.4: A good, capable wife makes her husband proud. \q But a wife who brings him shame is like a disease that eats away his bones.

decisions.choice: a wife of strength: a capable, worthy wife
decisions.reason: The phrase (eshet hayil) returns in 31:10. Hayil is strength, ability and worth; Boaz calls Ruth the same (Ruth 3:11).

decisions.choice: rot in his bones: a hidden, deep ruin
decisions.reason: Decay in the bones eats from within (14:30; Habakkuk 3:16).

records.source: מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת צַדִּיקִ֣ים מִשְׁפָּ֑ט תַּחְבֻּל֖וֹת רְשָׁעִ֣ים מִרְמָֽה׃
records.gloss: [The] plans of righteous [people] [are] justice; [the] guidance of wicked [people] [is] deceit.
pieces: The plans of the righteous are fair, \q but the advice of the wicked is full of deceit.

L.5: [The] plans of [the] righteous [are] just; \q [the] counsels of [the] wicked [are] deceit.

R.5: Good people plan to do what is fair. \q Evil people plan to trick others.

decisions.choice: counsels: steering (1:5), here in a bad sense
decisions.reason: The steering word of 1:5 and 11:14; the wicked steer toward deceit.

records.source: דִּבְרֵ֣י רְשָׁעִ֣ים אֱרָב־דָּ֑ם וּפִ֥י יְ֝שָׁרִ֗ים יַצִּילֵֽם׃
records.gloss: [The] words of wicked [people] [are] to lie in wait for blood, but [the] mouth of upright [people] delivers them.
pieces: When the wicked speak, they are setting an ambush to kill, \q but what the upright say rescues them.

L.6: [The] words of [the] wicked [are an] ambush for blood, \q but [the] mouth of [the] upright rescues them.

R.6: Evil people use words to trap and kill others. \q But the words of good people save lives.

decisions.choice: lie in wait for blood: the gang of 1:11
decisions.reason: The words of the gang in 1:11.

decisions.choice: rescues them: the upright, or the victims
decisions.reason: "Them" may be the upright themselves or the people the wicked are lying in wait for.

records.source: הָפ֣וֹךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים וְאֵינָ֑ם וּבֵ֖ית צַדִּיקִ֣ים יַעֲמֹֽד׃
records.gloss: Overthrow wicked [people], and they are no [more], but [the] house of righteous [people] will stand.
pieces: The wicked are overthrown and gone, \q but the house of the righteous will stand firm.

L.7: [The] wicked are overthrown and are no more, \q but [the] house of [the] righteous will stand.

R.7: Evil people are destroyed and are gone. \q But the families of good people will last.

decisions.choice: overthrown ... the house will stand: as in 10:25
decisions.reason: The word for overthrow (haphak) is used of Sodom (Genesis 19:25). Compare Jesus' house on the rock (Matthew 7:24–27).

records.source: לְֽפִי־שִׂ֭כְלוֹ יְהֻלַּל־אִ֑ישׁ וְנַעֲוֵה־לֵ֝֗ב יִהְיֶ֥ה לָבֽוּז׃
records.gloss: According to his insight a person is praised, but [one] perverse of heart will be for contempt.
pieces: People are praised for their good sense, \q but the one with a twisted mind is held in contempt.

L.8: A person is praised according to {{gender:their|his}} insight, \q but one twisted of heart will be despised.

R.8: People praise those who have good sense. \q But they look down on people whose thinking is twisted.

decisions.choice: insight: good sense
decisions.reason: The word (sekel) of 3:4.

records.source: ט֣וֹב נִ֭קְלֶה וְעֶ֣בֶד ל֑וֹ מִ֝מְּתַכַּבֵּ֗ד וַחֲסַר־לָֽחֶם׃
records.gloss: Better [is one] lightly regarded and a servant [is] his, than [one] honoring himself and lacking bread.
pieces: Better to be a nobody with a servant \q than to put on airs and have nothing to eat.

L.9: Better [is one] lightly regarded who has a servant \q than one who honors {{gender:themselves|himself}} but lacks bread.

R.9: It is better to be an ordinary person who has enough \q than to act important and have nothing to eat.

decisions.choice: better ... than: a comparison saying
decisions.reason: The first of many "better than" sayings (15:16–17; 16:8).

decisions.choice: has a servant: or works for himself
decisions.reason: With other vowels the line reads "who works for himself". Either way the point is modest self-sufficiency against empty show.

records.source: יוֹדֵ֣עַ צַ֭דִּיק נֶ֣פֶשׁ בְּהֶמְתּ֑וֹ וְֽרַחֲמֵ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים אַכְזָרִֽי׃
records.gloss: A righteous [person] knows [the] life of his animal, but [the] compassion of wicked [people] [is] cruel.
pieces: The righteous take care of their animals, \q but even the kindness of the wicked is cruel.

L.10: [The] righteous knows the needs of {{gender:their|his}} animal, \q but [the] mercy of [the] wicked [is] cruel.

R.10: Good people are kind even to their animals. \q But even when evil people try to be kind, they are cruel.

decisions.choice: knows the life: cares for the needs
decisions.reason: To "know the life (nephesh)" of an animal is to know what it needs (Exodus 23:12; Deuteronomy 25:4).

records.source: עֹבֵ֣ד אַ֭דְמָתוֹ יִֽשְׂבַּֽע־לָ֑חֶם וּמְרַדֵּ֖ף רֵיקִ֣ים חֲסַר־לֵֽב׃
records.gloss: [One] working his land will be satisfied [with] bread, but [one] pursuing empty [things] [is] lacking heart.
pieces: Those who work their land will have plenty to eat, \q but those who chase fantasies have no sense.

L.11: Whoever works {{gender:their|his}} land will have plenty of bread, \q but whoever chases empty things lacks heart.

R.11: People who work hard on their farms will have plenty of food. \q People who waste time on useless things are foolish.

decisions.choice: empty things: worthless pursuits
decisions.reason: The word (reqim) means empty things or empty people (Judges 9:4). The ancient Greek adds a further line here.

records.source: חָמַ֣ד רָ֭שָׁע מְצ֣וֹד רָעִ֑ים וְשֹׁ֖רֶשׁ צַדִּיקִ֣ים יִתֵּֽן׃
records.gloss: A wicked [person] covets [the] net of evil [people], but [the] root of righteous [people] gives.
pieces: The wicked want what evil people have caught, \q but the root of the righteous bears fruit.

L.12: [The] wicked covets [the] catch of evil [people], \q but [the] root of [the] righteous yields [fruit].

R.12: Evil people want what other evil people have stolen. \q But good people are like a healthy tree that bears fruit.

decisions.choice: the catch of evil people: what they take as plunder
decisions.reason: The line is hard. The net (matsod) may be the catch, or a stronghold. Many corrections have been proposed.

records.source: בְּפֶ֣שַׁע שְׂ֭פָתַיִם מוֹקֵ֣שׁ רָ֑ע וַיֵּצֵ֖א מִצָּרָ֣ה צַדִּֽיק׃
records.gloss: In [the] transgression of lips [is] an evil snare, but a righteous [person] comes out from trouble.
pieces: The wicked are trapped by their sinful talk, \q but the righteous get out of trouble.

L.13: In [the] transgression of [the] lips [is] an evil snare, \q but [the] righteous comes out of trouble.

R.13: Evil people are trapped by the wrong things they say. \q But good people escape from trouble.

decisions.choice: the transgression of the lips: sinful speech
decisions.reason: Careless or wicked words become a trap for the speaker (18:7).

records.source: מִפְּרִ֣י פִי־אִ֭ישׁ יִשְׂבַּע־ט֑וֹב וּגְמ֥וּל יְדֵי־אָ֝דָ֗ם יָשִׁ֥יב לֽוֹ׃
records.gloss: From [the] fruit of [the] mouth of a person he is satisfied [with] good, and [the] work of [the] hands of a person returns to him.
pieces: People are filled with good things by the fruit of their words, \q and the work of their hands comes back to them.

L.14: From [the] fruit of {{gender:their|his}} mouth a person is filled with good, \q and [the] work of a person's hands returns to {{gender:them|him}}.

R.14: Good words bring good things to the people who say them. \q And people are rewarded for their work.

decisions.choice: returns, as the scribes' reading has it
decisions.reason: The written consonants (ketiv) read "it will return"; the reading the scribes marked (qere) is "he will repay". The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: the fruit of the mouth: what words produce
decisions.reason: Words bear fruit as deeds do (13:2; 18:20).

records.source: דֶּ֣רֶךְ אֱ֭וִיל יָשָׁ֣ר בְּעֵינָ֑יו וְשֹׁמֵ֖עַ לְעֵצָ֣ה חָכָֽם׃
records.gloss: [The] way of a fool [is] right in his eyes, but [one] listening to advice [is] wise.
pieces: Fools think their own way is right, \q but the wise listen to advice.

L.15: [The] way of a fool [is] right in {{gender:their|his}} own eyes, \q but whoever listens to advice [is] wise.

R.15: Foolish people think they are always right. \q Wise people listen to advice.

decisions.choice: right in his own eyes: as in 3:7
decisions.reason: Compare 3:7 and 16:2.

records.source: אֱוִ֗יל בַּ֭יּוֹם יִוָּדַ֣ע כַּעְס֑וֹ וְכֹסֶ֖ה קָל֣וֹן עָרֽוּם׃
records.gloss: A fool, on [the] day his anger is known, but [one] covering shame [is] prudent.
pieces: A fool shows annoyance at once, \q but a prudent person overlooks an insult.

L.16: A fool's anger is known at once, \q but one who covers an insult [is] prudent.

R.16: Fools show their anger right away. \q Wise people ignore insults.

decisions.choice: on the day: at once, the same day
decisions.reason: The fool's anger shows the moment it is felt.

decisions.choice: covers an insult: overlooks it, does not show offense
decisions.reason: The word (qalon) is shame or dishonor. The prudent let it pass (19:11).

records.source: יָפִ֣יחַ אֱ֭מוּנָה יַגִּ֣יד צֶ֑דֶק וְעֵ֖ד שְׁקָרִ֣ים מִרְמָֽה׃
records.gloss: [One who] breathes faithfulness declares righteousness, but a witness of lies, deceit.
pieces: An honest witness tells what is right, \q but a false witness tells lies.

L.17: One who breathes out truth declares what is right, \q but a false witness [declares] deceit.

R.17: An honest witness tells the truth in court. \q A lying witness tells lies.

decisions.choice: a witness: testimony in court
decisions.reason: The setting is the law court (6:19; 14:5, 25).

records.source: יֵ֣שׁ בּ֭וֹטֶהכְּמַדְקְר֣וֹת חָ֑רֶב וּלְשׁ֖וֹן חֲכָמִ֣ים מַרְפֵּֽא׃
records.gloss: There is [one] speaking rashly like thrusts of a sword, but [the] tongue of wise [people] [is] healing.
pieces: Thoughtless words cut like a sword, \q but what the wise say heals.

L.18: There is one who speaks rashly like thrusts of a sword, \q but [the] tongue of [the] wise [is] healing.

R.18: Careless words can hurt like a knife. \q But the words of wise people help heal.

decisions.choice: speaks rashly: blurts out
decisions.reason: The verb (bata) is used of a rash vow (Leviticus 5:4; Numbers 30:6).

records.source: שְֽׂפַת־אֱ֭מֶת תִּכּ֣וֹן לָעַ֑ד וְעַד־אַ֝רְגִּ֗יעָה לְשׁ֣וֹן שָֽׁקֶר׃
records.gloss: A lip of truth will be established forever, but until I blink, a tongue of falsehood.
pieces: Truthful words endure forever, \q but a lie is over in the blink of an eye.

L.19: Truthful lips will stand firm forever, \q but a lying tongue [lasts only] for a moment.

R.19: The truth lasts forever. \q But a lie lasts only a short time.

decisions.choice: until I blink: for an instant
decisions.reason: "Until I wink (or give rest)" means only a moment (Jeremiah 49:19).

records.source: מִ֭רְמָה בְּלֶב־חֹ֣רְשֵׁי רָ֑ע וּֽלְיֹעֲצֵ֖י שָׁל֣וֹם שִׂמְחָֽה׃
records.gloss: Deceit [is] in [the] heart of those devising evil, but to counselors of peace [is] joy.
pieces: There is deceit in the hearts of those who plot evil, \q but joy for those who work for peace.

L.20: Deceit [is] in [the] heart of those who plot evil, \q but those who counsel peace [have] joy.

R.20: People who plan evil are full of lies. \q But people who try to make peace are full of joy.

decisions.choice: deceit ... joy: an unexpected pair
decisions.reason: The contrast is not deceit and honesty but deceit and joy: plotting harm brings no happiness (14:22).

records.source: לֹא־יְאֻנֶּ֣ה לַצַּדִּ֣יק כָּל־אָ֑וֶן וּ֝רְשָׁעִ֗ים מָ֣לְאוּ רָֽע׃
records.gloss: No harm happens to the righteous, but wicked [people] are full of trouble.
pieces: No real harm comes to the righteous, \q but the wicked are full of trouble.

L.21: No harm befalls the righteous, \q but [the] wicked are filled with trouble.

R.21: Nothing truly bad will happen to good people. \q But evil people will have many troubles.

decisions.choice: no harm: no ruin, as a general truth
decisions.reason: Like 10:27, a general rule under God's care (Psalm 91:10), not a promise that the righteous never suffer (Job 1–2).

records.source: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה שִׂפְתֵי־שָׁ֑קֶר וְעֹשֵׂ֖י אֱמוּנָ֣ה רְצוֹנֽוֹ׃
records.gloss: An abomination of YHWH [are] lips of falsehood, but those doing faithfulness [are] his delight.
pieces: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} detests lying lips, \q but people who keep faith are {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} delight.

L.22: Lying lips [are] an abomination to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q but those who act faithfully [are] {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} delight.

R.22: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} hates lying. \q But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is happy with people who are honest.

decisions.choice: abomination ... delight: as in 11:1, 20

records.source: אָדָ֣ם עָ֭רוּם כֹּ֣סֶה דָּ֑עַת וְלֵ֥ב כְּ֝סִילִ֗ים יִקְרָ֥א אִוֶּֽלֶת׃
records.gloss: A prudent person conceals knowledge, but [the] heart of fools proclaims folly.
pieces: Sensible people keep what they know to themselves, \q but the minds of fools blurt out folly.

L.23: A prudent person conceals knowledge, \q but [the] heart of fools proclaims folly.

R.23: Wise people do not show off what they know. \q Fools say foolish things for everyone to hear.

decisions.choice: conceals knowledge: as in 10:14

records.source: יַד־חָרוּצִ֥ים תִּמְשׁ֑וֹל ו֝רְמִיָּ֗התִּהְיֶ֥ה לָמַֽס׃
records.gloss: [The] hand of diligent [people] will rule, but slackness will become forced labor.
pieces: Hard workers will end up in charge, \q but the lazy will be made to work for others.

L.24: [The] hand of [the] diligent will rule, \q but [the] slack will be put to forced labor.

R.24: People who work hard will become leaders. \q Lazy people will end up doing forced labor.

decisions.choice: forced labor: work imposed by others
decisions.reason: The word (mas) is labor demanded by a ruler (1 Kings 9:21).

records.source: דְּאָגָ֣ה בְלֶב־אִ֣ישׁ יַשְׁחֶ֑נָּה וְדָבָ֖ר ט֣וֹב יְשַׂמְּחֶֽנָּה׃
records.gloss: Anxiety in [the] heart of a person bows it down, but a good word makes it glad.
pieces: Worry weighs down the heart, \q but a kind word lifts it up.

L.25: Anxiety in a person's heart weighs it down, \q but a good word makes it glad.

R.25: Worry makes people feel sad. \q But a kind word makes them happy.

decisions.choice: anxiety: worry
decisions.reason: The word (deagah) is anxious care (Ezekiel 12:18).

records.source: יָתֵ֣ר מֵרֵעֵ֣הוּ צַדִּ֑יק וְדֶ֖רֶךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים תַּתְעֵֽם׃
records.gloss: A righteous [person] searches out his friend, but [the] way of wicked [people] leads them astray.
pieces: The righteous give their friends good direction, \q but the road the wicked take leads them astray.

L.26: [The] righteous guides {{gender:their|his}} neighbor, \q but [the] way of [the] wicked leads them astray.

R.26: Good people help their friends find the right way. \q But evil people lead others the wrong way.

decisions.choice: guides: scouts out, shows the way
decisions.reason: The verb (yater) is rare and unclear. It may mean to search out or guide, or (with other vowels) "has an advantage over".

records.source: לֹא־יַחֲרֹ֣ךְ רְמִיָּ֣ה צֵיד֑וֹ וְהוֹן־אָדָ֖ם יָקָ֣ר חָרֽוּץ׃
records.gloss: Slackness does not roast his game, but [the] wealth of a person [is] precious, diligent.
pieces: The lazy never cook what they catch, \q but the diligent value what they have.

L.27: [The] slack do not roast {{gender:their|his}} game, \q but [the] wealth of a diligent person [is] precious.

R.27: Lazy people do not finish what they start. \q Hard workers take good care of what they have.

decisions.choice: does not roast his game: never finishes the job
decisions.reason: The verb (harak) is rare; it may mean to roast or to catch. The lazy start but do not finish (19:24).

records.source: בְּאֹֽרַח־צְדָקָ֥ה חַיִּ֑ים וְדֶ֖רֶךְ נְתִיבָ֣ה אַל־מָֽוֶת׃
records.gloss: In [the] path of righteousness [is] life, and [the] way of [its] path [is] no death.
pieces: On the road of righteousness there is life; \q along that path there is no death.

L.28: In [the] path of righteousness [is] life, \q and in [its] pathway [there is] no death.

R.28: Doing what is right leads to life. \q That road does not lead to death.

decisions.choice: no death: immortality, or freedom from an early death
alternatives: the way of the pathway leads to death (other vowels)
decisions.reason: The words "not death" (al-mawet) may mean "immortality", a striking claim. With other vowels the line reads "but a winding path leads to death".
